scenarios.title: Torpor Orb: a creature entering causes no abilities to trigger
instructions: With Torpor Orb on the battlefield, cast Scenario Mystic ("When this creature enters, you gain 3 life").
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Scenario Mystic enters but its trigger never happens: life stays at 40.
